summary: @servicetitan/unit-tests ships obfuscated preinstall payload executed via downloaded Bun runtime
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the bun binary, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line @bun-cjs bundle with rotated string-array obfuscation (character-array plus rotator function, opaque hex identifiers) that is not referenced by the library's main entry and only executes through the preinstall step. Using a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime to execute a heavily obfuscated bundle at install time evades Node-based scanning and defeats static inspection of the executed code. The package publishes under the @servicetitan npm scope while its declared repository points to github.com/servicetitan/playground.git and it carries an empty description and unrelated README, consistent with namespace impersonation of the ServiceTitan corporate scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
